title: Container Report - Week 46
summary:
Container
The container shipping market experienced a relatively subdued week, with the Baltic Exchange's four main east-west trades recording an average decline of 0.52%. Transpacific rates edged lower, with China/US West Coast falling 0.77%, while the East Coast remained unchanged. Asia-Europe rates also weakened slightly, with North Europe down 0.53% and the Mediterranean declining 0.79%.
